messages:
emma: Hi all - quick onboarding / security question. I'm using a company VM for dev work (no local prod creds) but my laptop is personal and I don't want to enable FileVault on it. Is there a BYOD exception process or a way to get dev access without full-disk encryption? Also saw a phish-sim invite but the emails are going to spam. Who do I contact to whitelist the sender or confirm my window?

people-ops: Welcome @emma! Tagging @alex-it for BYOD/encryption and @marco-security for phish/KMS questions.

alex-it: Hey Emma :wave: Short answer: if all access is via a company-managed VM and no prod creds are stored on the device, we can accept a signed BYOD agreement and a short attestation instead of enforcing FileVault. Please fill the BYOD form: https://redwood.example/forms/byod and add a note that you access prod only via VM. IT will run a quick checklist. If you later need local prod creds we will require full-disk encryption and MDM enrollment.

marco-security: Adding detail - BYOD + no-prod-only is acceptable with the signed form and a security attestation. We do a risk review for each case. If you want KMS read for staging only, submit a key-request with scope `kms:read:staging` and tag it `new-hire`. We can often grant ephemeral creds (1-4h) while the request is reviewed. For phish-sim: emails come from training@phishsim.io, subject starts with "Redwood Security Training". Check spam and add that address to your allow-list; if it's still missing, DM me and we'll re-send.

emma: Thanks - filing the BYOD form now. For the attestation, what exactly do you need (short template would help). Also I'll paste the phish-sim invite if it doesn't show up.

alex-it: Attestation template: 1) I confirm I will not store production secrets locally; 2) I will use the company VM for any prod access; 3) I understand security may revoke BYOD privilege if policy is violated. Sign and upload to the BYOD form. You can also request a company laptop if you prefer.

marco-security: Template sent to @emma via DM (also pasted in the form). Once you submit the BYOD form add a note "requires staging access only" and we'll fast-track. For ephemeral kms creds use the Dev Portal: https://devtools.redwood.internal/ephemeral. Example curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" https://devtools.redwood.internal/ephemeral -d '{"scope":"kms:read:staging","ttl":3600}'`.

security-bot: Reminder: New hire security training due in 7 days. Complete course SEC101: https://learn.redwood.ai/courses/sec101. Phish-sim FAQ: https://redwood.example/internal/phishsim-faq.

people-ops: LMK if you want us to reserve a company laptop for quicker prod onboarding. Welcome again! :slightly_smiling_face:
